columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Timestamp when the event was ingested into Log Analytics

columns.name: TxId
columns.description: The transaction ID of the authentication event

columns.name: EventTimestamp
columns.description: Unix timestamp of the event in seconds

columns.name: IsoTimestamp
columns.description: ISO8601 timestamp of the event

columns.name: Result
columns.description: Result of the authentication attempt: success, denied, failure, error, or fraud

columns.name: Reason
columns.description: Reason associated with the authentication attempt result

columns.name: Factor
columns.description: Authentication factor or method used (e.g. duo_push, sms_passcode, phone_call)

columns.name: EventType
columns.description: Type of activity logged: authentication or enrollment

columns.name: Alias
columns.description: Username alias used to log in, if any

columns.name: Email
columns.description: Email address of the authenticating user

columns.name: OodSoftware
columns.description: Name of out-of-date software if auth was denied for that reason

columns.name: TrustedEndpointStatus
columns.description: Whether the endpoint passed a Duo trusted endpoint check

columns.name: UserKey
columns.description: The authenticating user's user_id

columns.name: UserName
columns.description: The authenticating user's username

columns.name: UserGroups
columns.description: Duo group membership of the authenticating user

columns.name: ApplicationKey
columns.description: Integration key of the application accessed

columns.name: ApplicationName
columns.description: Name of the Duo-protected application accessed

columns.name: ApplicationDestinationName
columns.description: Destination app name passed by an OIDC Auth API application

columns.name: AuthDeviceName
columns.description: Name of the device used to approve or deny authentication

columns.name: AuthDeviceKey
columns.description: Duo identifier of the authentication device (phone_id, webauthnkey, etc.)

columns.name: AuthDeviceIp
columns.description: IP address of the authentication device

columns.name: AuthDeviceCity
columns.description: GeoIP city of the authentication device

columns.name: AuthDeviceState
columns.description: GeoIP state or province of the authentication device

columns.name: AuthDeviceCountry
columns.description: GeoIP country of the authentication device

columns.name: AccessDeviceIp
columns.description: IP address of the access device (browser/endpoint)

columns.name: AccessDeviceHostname
columns.description: Hostname of the access device, if present

columns.name: AccessDeviceOs
columns.description: Operating system of the access device

columns.name: AccessDeviceOsVersion
columns.description: Operating system version of the access device

columns.name: AccessDeviceBrowser
columns.description: Web browser used for access

columns.name: AccessDeviceBrowserVersion
columns.description: Version of the web browser used for access

columns.name: AccessDeviceEpkey
columns.description: Unique endpoint identifier, most reliable when reported by Duo Desktop

columns.name: AccessDeviceFlashVersion
columns.description: Flash plugin version on the access device, or 'uninstalled'

columns.name: AccessDeviceJavaVersion
columns.description: Java plugin version on the access device, or 'uninstalled'

columns.name: AccessDeviceIsEncryptionEnabled
columns.description: Disk encryption state as detected by Duo Desktop: true, false, or unknown

columns.name: AccessDeviceIsFirewallEnabled
columns.description: Firewall state as detected by Duo Desktop: true, false, or unknown

columns.name: AccessDeviceIsPasswordSet
columns.description: System password state as detected by Duo Desktop: true, false, or unknown

columns.name: AccessDeviceCity
columns.description: GeoIP city of the access device

columns.name: AccessDeviceState
columns.description: GeoIP state or province of the access device

columns.name: AccessDeviceCountry
columns.description: GeoIP country of the access device

columns.name: AccessDeviceSecurityAgents
columns.description: Security agents present on the endpoint as detected by Duo Desktop

columns.name: AdaptiveTrustAssessments
columns.description: Risk-based authentication assessment info (RBFS and RBRD)

columns.name: TrustedSessionUuid
columns.description: Unique identifier for tracking a remembered device trusted session

columns.name: PassportAssessment
columns.description: Duo Passport evaluation result indicating whether the authentication was supported by Passport
